name: Red Fox
caption: Spotted this fella trotting along the tree line just after sunrise — didn't even flinch when I raised the camera.

name: White-tailed Deer
caption: A young buck, antlers still in velvet. Ontario's forests are full of them this time of year.

name: Forest Elephant
caption: Forest elephants are shier and smaller than their savanna cousins — this was a rare, still moment.

name: Snow Leopard
caption: Three days of waiting in −15°C for this. Worth every hour.

name: Humpback Whale
caption: Breached twice within a minute — the boat nearly rocked us into the sea.

name: Great Horned Owl
caption: Heard the call for three nights before I finally found the nest.

name: Green Sea Turtle
caption: She surfaced right next to the boat for air, completely unbothered by us.

name: Red Fox
caption: Winter coat is coming in thick already — early sign of a cold season ahead.

name: Forest Elephant
caption: A small herd crossing the river at dusk. Counted six, including two calves.
